title: Concept: Nginx version disclosed in a response
description: An nginx version string inside an error page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The exact version lets an attacker match the host to its published advisories and pick the module that is known to be weak in that build.
applicability: Deployments that render an nginx version string inside an error page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The exact version lets an attacker match the host to its published advisories and pick the module that is known to be weak in that build.
